observer: Claude (AI visual inspection of zoomed, gridded crops of the protected canon, read-only). Not a human or director measurement.
coordinateNote: Pixel coordinates on the 1200x1600 canvas after studio placement() (front/back/left: 1152x1536 scaled uniformly x1.041667, exact fit; right: 1200x1600 1:1).
sideConvention: Left/Right in landmark names = screen-left/screen-right of each image (studio convention), not anatomical. Front: screen-left = character's right. Back: screen-left = character's left. Side views (left/right files): legs overlap; *Left = near (visible) limb, *Right = far (occluded) limb; anatomical side not asserted.
